about: Number-free descriptions of the ceremony rows the generated block `ceremony-rows` prints (src/glance/ceremonies.ts). Each row is a folder of ceremony run records in the results directory (ceremonies/<row>/). Outcomes of ceremonies run together (one pair, one carrier, one date); never conformance counts.
